name: Right-censored survival analysis (Python)
description: Kaplan–Meier, stratified log-rank, Breslow/Efron Cox with cluster-robust covariance, baseline survival and RMST, in numpy/scipy/pandas; numerically validated against R survival 3.8.6 and survRM2 1.0.4.

inputs.name: design
inputs.format: n x p fixed-covariate matrix without intercept, for Cox

inputs.name: tau
inputs.format: common time horizon for RMST or administrative censoring

outputs: KM estimates, Greenwood variance and confidence intervals
log-rank scores, covariance, chi-square, df and p
Cox coefficients, model/cluster covariance, observed information and tests
baseline cumulative hazards and individual survival
RMST estimates, variances and group difference
